intent.purpose: TikTok slideshow hook frame: a real-looking late-night selfie before bed
intent.scene_concept: warm, dim bedroom at night, front-camera selfie lit by the phone screen and one bedside lamp
intent.place_type: lived-in home bedroom (not a hotel, not a studio set)
must_stay_true: it is night and the room is mostly dark
the only light is a bedside lamp plus the phone screen glow on the face
the room looks lived in, not staged

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: as attractive as or more attractive than the source posts this scene class came from; the rawness is in the photo, not in her looks
appeal.face: striking, well-proportioned face with full lips and bright eyes, relaxed and pretty at night without makeup
appeal.physique: slim with a soft hourglass shape; only shoulders and upper chest in frame

subject.description: one woman taking a casual selfie in her bedroom before sleeping
subject.action: holding the phone at arm's length with her right hand and taking a front-camera selfie
subject.pose: sitting up against the headboard, shoulders relaxed and slightly uneven, torso angled a little to frame left, head tilted a few degrees
subject.gaze: at the phone screen, which reads as looking just off the lens

identity.skin: light-medium warm skin, clear and healthy, a faint natural flush around the nose, fine visible pores on nose and cheeks
identity.hair: long dark-blonde hair with darker roots, loose waves flattened on one side from the pillow, a few flyaways catching the lamp
identity.face: striking, well-proportioned face with natural asymmetry, no makeup except leftover mascara, a little sleepy-eyed at night

physique.build: slim with a soft hourglass shape
physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions, natural shoulders and neck
physique.detail: only head, shoulders and upper chest are in frame

items: faded grey oversized crew-neck sleep t-shirt with a small bleach spot
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: t-shirt worn and stretched at the collar, creased from lying down

foreground: corner of a rumpled white duvet at the bottom edge
background: bedside table at frame left with a fabric-shade lamp, a half-full water glass, a phone charger cable and a hair tie
plain beige wall with a small crooked framed print
dark doorway at frame right falling into shadow
environment.clutter: light everyday clutter: charger cable, hair tie, water glass, a paperback face-down

camera.position: arm's length, slightly above eye level, angled a little downward
camera.focus: face in focus but soft overall from low light
camera.depth_of_field: deep phone depth of field; the room behind is dim and noisy rather than creamy-blurred

composition.subject_placement: face slightly right of centre, lamp glow at upper left
composition.crop: top of the hair just touches the frame edge; one shoulder partly cut off

sources: bedside lamp with a warm fabric shade at frame left, around 2700K
cool blue-white glow from the phone screen on the face
lighting.direction: lamp from the left side, screen glow from the front
lighting.quality: soft but uneven; one side of the face warmer and brighter
lighting.exposure: underexposed room, face adequately exposed by auto-exposure; the lamp shade clips to white

color.white_balance: auto white balance leaning warm-orange, fighting the cool screen light
color.contrast: low-to-medium, lifted blacks from night mode
casts: orange cast on the left cheek and hair
faint blue cast on the nose and forehead from the screen

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app, Night mode auto, saved as HEIC then re-compressed by the app upload
processing.hdr: Smart HDR flattening the lamp highlight
processing.sharpening: slightly crunchy phone sharpening on hair edges
processing.noise_reduction: heavy phone noise reduction smearing fine detail in the dark background
processing.compression: visible social-media JPEG compression in the dark gradients
processing.beauty_filter: none; no skin smoothing, no face reshaping
processing.grading: none; straight out of the camera

imperfections: chroma and luminance noise in the shadows
blotchy noise-reduction smears on the wall
banding in the dark gradient behind her
slight motion softness from a long handheld exposure
a stray hair across the cheek

texture.skin: real pores, fine peach fuzz on the cheek catching the lamp, slight shine on the nose
texture.hair: individual strands and frizz visible at the edges, clumped where it was slept on
texture.surfaces: matte painted wall, glossy water glass with one small reflection

motion.subject: still
motion.blur: very slight overall softness, no directional streaks

anatomy: one head, two shoulders, correct neck length
the selfie arm extends toward the camera and leaves the frame at the lower right
the other hand is out of frame
physics: lamp light falls off naturally with distance
the necklace rests on the collarbone under gravity
the duvet folds where she sits
geometry.reflections: no mirrors in frame; the water glass shows a tiny warm reflection of the lamp only
geometry.perspective: front-camera wide perspective: the face is slightly larger than the shoulders, with no fisheye

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

typography.scene_text: none legible; the paperback spine is too dark to read

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding where it would really appear; do not invent logos or readable text that the scene would not have

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no studio lighting, ring light or catchlight rings
no cinematic colour grade, film grain, halation or vignette
no smooth, poreless or airbrushed skin
no glamour makeup or posed studio expression
no text, captions, UI, timestamps or watermarks
